messages:
Maria P.: Quick thread — need to align on audit evidence lifecycle & retention matrix for the compliance sprint. Customers (large enterprise pilot) require: per-tenant exports, legal-hold flag, BYOK/KMS for exported artifacts. I dropped a draft spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/retention-draft
Kevin L.: Can we scope types? logs, request traces, prompts, embeddings, and evals all have different needs.
Sasha R.: Agree. From infra POV: big cost diffs. Proposal: hot-searchable window = 30d, warm (reindex/searchable) = 1y, cold archive (on-demand retrieval) = 7y. Cold archive = compressed, encrypted, no token-level cost tracking.
Jordan (legal): Legal hold often requires indefinite retention until release. We need exportability + chain-of-custody. 48h turnaround for export is acceptable.
Priya (engops): Exports at scale are heavy. Need job queue + rate limits. Also per-tenant BYOK adds key management complexity: backup, rotate, escrow.
Maria P.: Acceptance criteria idea: 1) export contains full artifacts + signatures, 2) KMS/BYOK for exported blobs, 3) legal-hold toggles per-tenant, 4) retention policy enforcement audited in Console & logs.
Kevin L.: Want a retention matrix row per artifact type + default + customer override flags. Also, are we comfortable with trimmed prompts vs original user input? customers want original.
Sasha R.: For prompts & traces, retention length can be trimmed with opt-in. But default should keep originals for enterprise tier. We can add a "masked" derivative to preserve privacy but keep search indexing on derivatives.
Sasha R.: Implementation notes + small config example below.
Sasha R.: Example retention policy config:
```
retention:
  default: 365
  artifacts:
    prompts: 3650
    traces: 365
    embeddings: 730
  legal_hold: false
```
Jordan (legal): Masking is ok if consented. For SOC2 evidence we need access to original on request. Ensure we log who viewed/downloaded evidence.
Priya (engops): Ops question: export performance SLA — do we need background retry + signed manifests? I suggest CSV manifest + SHA256 per file.
Maria P.: Draft launch criteria for MVP:
- Per-tenant retention policies + Console UI
- Legal hold on/off with audit trail
- Export tool that produces signed tarball with manifest within 72h
- KMS-backed export encryption (BYOK opt-in)
- E2E tests and one pilot customer signoff
Kevin L.: Can we include rollback policy: if export fails, requeue and escalate to ops within 4h.
Sasha R.: Implementation notes: store retention metadata in RDS, blobs in GCS/S3 with lifecycle rules. Use object versioning + immutability for legal-hold. Need infra ticket.
Maria P.: Action items: @Sasha R. add infra RFC for tiered storage & immutability. @Priya add export worker capacity estimate and throttling plan. @Jordan list legal hold edgecases. I'll consolidate matrix and send to exec by Friday.
audit-bot: Compliance checklist updated: retention-matrix:v1 added by Maria P.
Kevin L.: +1. Any blockers from sales? Need to communicate tradeoffs to customers (searchability vs cost).
Sasha R.: I'll prototype a small demo showing cold retrieval latency & cost delta.
Maria P.: Thanks — will follow up in sync. :thumbsup:
